platform: Regional Free Tier (ShemarooMe / Hungama Play / JioCinema)

insights.ShemarooMe: Has extensive vintage Hindi, Gujarati, and Marathi free catalog. Accessible via web/mobile BFF REST endpoints.
insights.Hungama Play: Ad-supported movie catalog accessible via client JSON endpoints (`www.hungama.com/api/`).
insights.JioCinema: JioCinema and Disney+ Hotstar have officially consolidated into JioHotstar. Free tier content (like IPL, daily soaps, select movies) is accessible via JioHotstar BFF `api.hotstar.com`.
